item.text: I’m reviewing the current object model before touching it again. The next worthwhile refactor is likely around the remaining primitive `int` vertex IDs and the hand-rolled traversal state, so I’m checking those seams first.
I’m pushing the refactor through the vertex boundary now. The goal is to stop exposing raw `int` IDs across the graph/component APIs while keeping the example behavior and builder ergonomics intact.
There’s a small follow-up edit from the vertex refactor: one immutability test still constructs a component with raw integers. I’m fixing that and then compiling the whole set.
The vertex model refactor is in place. I’m compiling and running both the demo and the tests now to catch any API breakage from the type shift.
Verification passed. I’m pulling the updated line references so the close-out can point to the new vertex boundary and the affected APIs directly.

Refactored the graph API to use a real `Vertex` value object instead of passing raw `int` IDs through the domain layer. [Vertex.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/Vertex.java:1) now owns vertex identity and validation, [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/Graph.java:3) exposes `vertices()` and `neighborsOf(Vertex)`, and [UndirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/UndirectedGraph.java:4) stores vertices and adjacency lists in that typed form while keeping the builder’s `addEdge(int, int)` convenience.

That change propagated cleanly through the rest of the model. [ConnectedComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponent.java:4) now represents a list of `Vertex` objects, [GraphComponentFinder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/GraphComponentFinder.java:12) traverses typed vertices instead of primitive IDs, and [ComponentFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ComponentFormatter.java:6) is the only place that converts back to printable indexes. I also updated [ConnectedComponentsTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponentsTest.java:17) so it asserts vertex indexes explicitly through the new API and keeps the invalid-graph coverage aligned with the typed interface.

Verified with `javac *.java`, `java ConnectedComponents`, and `java ConnectedComponentsTest`.
